sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
TradeShowIntel is a trade show intelligence platform for exhibition organizers, exhibitors, and visitors.

Industry: Events & Trade Shows · Size: not published · Products: Trade show intelligence platform, Directory, Calendar, Blog, Resources, Spotlight

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: TradeShowIntel scores 11 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (11/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit, company size and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: No close match to a reference account. This lead stands on its own ICP fit rather than on resemblance to a known win.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
